concerns.text: T019 hardcodes the dataset source as 'farama/USPTO_Yields' on HuggingFace. Spec.md Assumptions and FR-001 state the dataset is accessible via a 'provided DOI link' (implying a specific paper's supplementary data). This task silently relaxes the data source constraint, violating Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) if the HuggingFace dataset diverges from the canonical source defined in the spec.

T022b implements a 'Stratified-by-Class + Intra-Class Scaffold Split' and explicitly excludes cross-class scaffolds. Spec.md FR-004 strictly mandates a 'scaffold-based split' to prevent leakage. The task's logic to exclude cross-class scaffolds is a silent relaxation of the split strategy not authorized by the spec, potentially altering the chemical space distribution and invalidating the generalization results required by SC-002.

T021 selects a 'fixed representative subset' of size '[deferred]' to meet RAM constraints. Spec.md FR-009 requires the system to process data 'by processing data in batches where necessary' to ensure RAM < 7GB. Relying on a static subset size rather than dynamic batched processing of the full dataset (or a clearly defined representative subset in the spec) silently relaxes the requirement to handle the full dataset via batching, risking failure of the feasibility constraint if the subset is too large.

T035a validates SC-003 by checking if top 3 substructures appear in >80% of 'high-yield' reactions (defined as top 10% quantile) within a derived 'sc003_val_indices' from the Validation set. Spec.md SC-003 requires validation against a 'held-out validation set' to prove interpretability. The task conflates the 'held-out' requirement with a post-hoc filtering of the validation set, silently relaxing the independence requirement of the validation set used for SC-003.

T015 defaults 'YIELD_RANGE_STRATEGY' to 'exclude' for yield ranges. Spec.md Edge Cases section explicitly asks 'How does the system handle reactions where the yield is reported as a range?' and suggests 'parse the midpoint' as a viable option. Defaulting to 'exclude' without a mandatory justification or a requirement to attempt parsing first silently relaxes the data utilization requirement, risking significant data bias not authorized by the spec.

T007a defines 'fingerprint_ecfp' and 'fingerprint_maccs' as 'list of int' in the JSON schema. Spec.md FR-003 and SC-001 require binary vectors (ECFP4/MACCS). Storing as integers silently relaxes the data type constraint, potentially breaking downstream scikit-learn or rdkit expectations that expect boolean/bit-mask inputs, violating the fidelity of the feature extraction pipeline.
